# Bundled OCR assets

The transcript recognizer runs entirely in the user's browser. It does not send PDF pages or extracted text to an OCR API.

- `eng.traineddata.gz` is the English model from [tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast](https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast), licensed under Apache-2.0.
- `worker.min.js` is copied at build time from the `tesseract.js` npm dependency.
- `tesseract-core.wasm.js` is copied at build time from `tesseract.js-core`.

The worker and WebAssembly core are generated by `prepare-temp-dir.mjs` from the lockfile-installed dependencies. The English model is stored locally under `tessdata/`, so recognition does not depend on a third-party OCR endpoint or model CDN at runtime.
